acceptance_criteria: OBS-03 audit rows written on create/delete in tenant schema
description: TC-EXT-02-INT-08 (Create/delete operations write OBS-03 audit rows atomically) fails with PgError.ServerError at ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig:681 when querying webhook_subscription_audit or related audit table. The test expects audit rows to be written atomically on subscription create/delete. Either the audit table does not exist in the tenant schema, a required column is missing, or the query is using wrong schema context.
title: TC-EXT-02-INT-08: PgError.ServerError querying OBS-03 audit rows for webhook subscription
resolution: DUPLICATE of ISS-0637/GH-619 (PR #622, merged 2026-08-09). Same test (TC-EXT-02-INT-08), same failure line (ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig:681, the audit_entries query), same PgError.ServerError symptom -- both filed independently from different WF-03 runs (WF03-GH381-20260809 for this one, WF03-GH616-20260809 for ISS-0637) before either fix landed. ISS-0637's diagnosis found the actual root cause: audit_entries.resource_id was changed from UUID to TEXT by migration GBL-120 (ISS-103), but the test still cast the bind parameter to ::uuid, producing C42883 (not a missing table/column/schema-context issue as this issue's 'probable root cause' speculated). No separate fix needed here. Verified on current main: zig build test-integration-ext02 -- 10/10 tests pass, including TC-EXT-02-INT-08.
